title: Roamhaven Rewards Long-Stay Benefit: First-Month Service Fee Courtesy
content:
# Roamhaven Rewards long-stay benefit — courtesy on the first month's guest service fee

**Benefit term.** Roamhaven Rewards members who book a long reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category get a courtesy on the guest service fee of its first month:

1. on a stay paid in monthly installments, a guest whose active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes a dedicated concierge is spared 100 percent of installment 1's guest service fee;
2. on a stay paid in monthly installments, a guest whose active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes the priority support line but no dedicated concierge is spared 50 percent of it;
3. any other guest pays all of it.

Installment 1 of a stay paid in monthly installments carries its guest service fee less this courtesy, following the guest's Roamhaven Rewards tier active when installment 1 is collected. The courtesy is applied to the fee before it is rounded.

## Benefit matrix

| Payment plan | Active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes | Part of installment 1's guest service fee spared |
|---|---|---|
| monthly installments | a dedicated concierge | 100 percent |
| monthly installments | the priority support line, no dedicated concierge | 50 percent |
| monthly installments | neither, or no active membership | none |
| pay-part-now or paid in full | anything | none |

## Illustration (hypothetical installment 1 fee of 462.00 before the courtesy)

Concierge tier: 0.00 is charged. Priority support line tier: 231.00 is charged. A guest whose membership is not active when installment 1 is collected: 462.00 is charged.
